title: Classic Turkey Chili
description: Hearty ground turkey chili with black beans, kidney beans and warm spices.
steps: Sauté the onion and pepper, then add jalapeño, garlic and tomato paste.
Brown the turkey, then stir in the spices.
Add the tomatoes and beans, and simmer 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
notes: This tastes even better the next day — make a double batch and freeze half.
